retrievalProfile.description: A centered luminous sphere filled with swirling blue and purple smoke against a dark, textured background with multiline display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A large, translucent sphere dominates the lower two-thirds of the frame, containing a dense, ethereal cloud of blue and violet smoke. The sphere has a bright cyan rim light on the left. Above it, stylized multiline typography is centered against a deep navy-to-black gradient background.
coreVisualRelationships: The sphere acts as a heavy visual anchor centered at the bottom.
The typography is stacked and centered, creating a vertical axis of symmetry.
The internal smoke texture contrasts with the smooth, reflective surface of the sphere.
The cyan rim light on the sphere balances the white highlights in the text.
coreInvariants: Deep blue and black color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central sphere occupying 60% of the frame; text occupies the top 30%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glowing cyan highlight on the lower-left edge of the sphere.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold multiline title at the top, down to the subtitle, and finally into the swirling details of the sphere.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black/navy void surrounding the sphere and text provides high contrast.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan/Electric Blue (Rim light and smoke highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the glowing sphere and the dark void; low saturation in the background with high saturation in the light effects.
paletteRestrictions: No warm tones like red or orange
Limited to blues, purples, and white

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses 4-5 parallel concentric lines to form each character
Secondary text uses ultra-thin monolinear strokes
Uniform stroke width within each style
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' is a series of concentric circles
The 'S' is a continuous multiline curve
The 'Y' has a wide, symmetrical fork
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A complex multiline display face paired with a hairline-thin geometric sans-serif for hierarchy.

avoid: Heavy solid blocks of color in text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the secondary hairline geometric style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark navy textured background with a large, centered glass sphere. Inside the sphere, render a swirling nebula of blue and purple smoke. Add a bright cyan rim light on the left side of the sphere.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a multiline concentric display font for the main title at the top. Below it, add a secondary line of text in an ultra-thin geometric sans-serif. Ensure all text is centered and white.

verificationChecks: Does the smoke have a mix of blue and violet tones?
Is the main title composed of multiple parallel lines?
Is the background a dark, slightly grainy gradient?

adjustableVariables: Number of lines in the display font
Intensity of the cyan rim light
mustRedesign: Do not use the Tamla logo
Ensure the smoke pattern is unique

avoid: Solid white text without line detail

postGenerationChecks: Confirm the typography is centered and legible.
Check that the smoke looks volumetric rather than a flat texture.
Ensure the color palette remains strictly in the blue/purple/black range.
Verify the multiline font effect is consistent across all letters.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered [Subject: Luminous Object] + [Atmosphere: Swirling Vapor] + [Top: Multiline Display Typography] + [Palette: Deep Blue/Cyan/Violet]
